items.title: Nancy Wilson interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, November 16, 1995
items.q: So when I listen to the things that Leonard — Leonard Feather used to get on me.

ctx.x: So when I listen to the things that Leonard — Leonard Feather used to get on me. It would be I was not as jazz, I mean I was not a true jazz artist. Well I’ve never professed to be. What does that mean, being a true jazz artist?
Good question. What does a true jazz vocalist mean? Do you have to scat? Do you have to —
